New bills now start with an 18% tip, and there's an 18% button between 15% and 20%.

A bill you'd already saved before this change keeps whatever tip it had. The 18% default only applies to a new bill or after Reset.

Switching: picking 20% and then 18% again goes back to $59.00.
Reload: after a page reload, 18% is still selected.
Mobile: the four buttons fit on one row, and nothing scrolls sideways.
